description: This Java file defines a factory class 'DataSourcePerTenantServiceFactory' responsible for creating DataSource instances for different tenants in a multi-tenant application. It manages configuration, security, and monitoring aspects for tenant-specific database connections.

classes.name: DataSourcePerTenantServiceFactory
classes.description: A Spring component that provides functionality to generate tenant-specific DataSource instances based on various configuration and security parameters.

methods.name: createNewDataSourceFor
methods.description: Creates a new DataSource object tailored to a specific tenant and connection information, handling validation, configuration, and metrics integration.

methods.name: getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Determines the maximum pool size for the tenant DataSource, considering global overrides or tenant-specific settings.

methods.name: getMinPoolSize
methods.description: Determines the minimum pool size for the tenant DataSource, considering global overrides or tenant-specific settings.
